environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway attached. Security group allows inbound on port 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. Task role has s3:PutObject on the shared data bucket. The /var/data/workspace/uploads path is backed by an EFS mount shared with a Lambda processing pipeline that executes uploaded scripts matching *.sh patterns.

config.network: public subnet with IGW, SG ingress 0.0.0.0/0:8080
config.storage: EFS mount shared with Lambda processor
config.processing: Lambda function polls EFS for new .sh files and executes them
